title: The Hill of Venus

As he reaches his father's bedside, the gravity of the situation becomes clear—Gregorio is dying and harbors a heavy burden of guilt regarding Francesco’s origins. Their poignant conversation reveals the elder Villani's desperate wish for atonement through his son's vow to the Church, thrusting Francesco into a world of obligation and longing for a life not meant for him, thus setting the stage for the unfolding drama of his conflicts—both internal and external.
